# Mastering dependencies

ShadowBuster bundles the following upstream components for audio processing. The corresponding source and release information for each bundled version are available at these links. The upstream license texts are included in this directory.

| Component | Upstream version and source | Included license |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ZL Compressor | [Release 0.6.1 and source](https://github.com/ZL-Audio/ZLCompressor/releases/tag/0.6.1) | `AGPL-3.0.md` |
| ZL Limiter | [Release 0.0.1 and source](https://github.com/ZL-Audio/ZLLimiter/releases/tag/0.0.1) | `AGPL-3.0.md` |
| pedalboard | [Source for v0.9.26](https://github.com/spotify/pedalboard/tree/v0.9.26) | `GPL-3.0.txt` |
| Matchering | [Source for 2.0.6](https://github.com/sergree/matchering/tree/2.0.6) | `GPL-3.0.txt` |
